title: The Only 3 Humans Who Died in Space Landed Perfectly

scenes.voiceover: The only three humans who have ever died in space came home in a perfect landing.
scenes.mainText: THEY DIED IN SPACE. THE LANDING WAS PERFECT.
scenes.visualConcept: Soyuz 11 crew stamp — three faces, instantly human.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: Soyuz 11 crew stamp — three faces, instantly human.

scenes.voiceover: June 1971. Three cosmonauts head home after a record three weeks aboard the first space station in history.
scenes.mainText: 3 WEEKS ON THE FIRST SPACE STATION

scenes.voiceover: Retrofire, clean. Reentry, clean. Parachute open. A textbook touchdown on the steppe.
scenes.visualConcept: Reentry capsule on display — scorched, intact.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: Reentry capsule on display — scorched, intact.

scenes.voiceover: Recovery crews opened the hatch and found all three men in their couches. Calm. Composed. Dead.
scenes.visualConcept: Recovery vehicles on the steppe — the moment of discovery.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: Recovery vehicles on the steppe — the moment of discovery.

scenes.voiceover: A valve had been jolted open one hundred sixty eight kilometers up. Their air hissed into vacuum in under a minute.
scenes.mainText: ONE VALVE. 168 KM UP. AIR GONE IN <60s
scenes.visualConcept: Stat slam over dark orbital Earth.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: Stat slam over dark orbital Earth.

scenes.voiceover: They wore no pressure suits. There was no room. Not one cosmonaut has flown reentry without one since.
scenes.mainText: NO ONE FLIES WITHOUT A SUIT SINCE
scenes.visualConcept: The crew's three faces again — the rule written in their names.
scenes.backgroundPrompt: The crew's three faces again — the rule written in their names.

scenes.voiceover: The Soviet Union hid the cause for years. What else they buried is on the channel.
scenes.mainText: WHAT ELSE THEY BURIED → ON THE CHANNEL
